svg.title: Minor sixth (m6): information sheet, phone layout
svg.desc: Minor sixth, m6: C4 to A♭4, 8 semitones. A keyboard from C4 to C5 with both keys highlighted in this interval's identity colour and 8 numbered semitone hops. Two time strips show the notes one after another and together. Plogger [8] lens: Modal family (rounded), → Octave, Non-harmonic (Plogger), dense/dark.

g.text: 6 letter names counted inclusively (C to A)
HOW TO READ THE THREE PLOGGER MARKS
perfect-group family. A family label, not a
The identity colour is a separate, artistic
Root C4 stays; upper note A♭4→G4, one key
apart. Plogger: A changes, B same, C changes.
Root C4 stays; upper note A♭4→A4, one key
apart. Plogger: A same, B same, C changes.
How to read: find C4 on your keyboard, then
count 8 keys up, white and black, to A♭4.
The numbered arcs are those hops. Top left
shows the two notes one after another, top
right the same two notes together.
